full_prompt_en: A square graphite-toned illustration shows two figures standing back to back before a wide pale coastal distance. The nearer young woman occupies the left foreground in profile, her head bowed and dark hair gathered into a low knot. Her black outer garment forms the darkest shape in the image, while a long pale scarf descends over her chest. Behind and to the right, an older man in a flat cap and gray coat lowers his head in the opposite direction. Short beard texture and fine creases define his profile, and his shoulder overlaps the woman's dark silhouette. Their backs meet along the center, yet their gazes separate, creating a quiet emotional distance. Most of the background remains warm off-white. Near the top left, a faint rectangular building sits on the horizon with tiny dark figures beside it. Small dark bird marks scatter across the open air and near the lower left, while thin horizontal lines suggest a distant shore or water. The two bodies are rendered with careful graphite shading and restrained ink accents; the woman's black clothing is denser and smoother, while the man's coat dissolves into lighter gray strokes toward the bottom. A faint seam-like line and subtle paper stains remain visible across the pale ground. Illumination is diffuse and shadowless, with tonal contrast rather than a clear light beam separating the subjects from the empty space. No readable text appears. The overall composition is spare and melancholic, setting two concentrated profiles against an expansive, nearly blank horizon.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形石墨色调插画呈现两名人物背靠背站在宽阔浅色海岸远景前。较近的年轻女子占据左侧前景侧面，低着头，深色头发在脑后盘成低髻。她的黑色外衣形成画中最深的形状，一条长浅色围巾垂过胸前。后方偏右，一名戴鸭舌帽、穿灰色外套的年长男子向相反方向低头。短胡须肌理和细纹刻画他的侧脸，肩膀与女子的暗色剪影重叠。两人的后背在中央相接，目光却分离，形成安静的情感距离。背景大部分保持暖灰白。左上方地平线附近，一幢浅淡矩形建筑旁有极小的深色人影。小小的深色鸟形散布在开阔空中和左下附近，细横线暗示远处海岸或水面。两具身体以细致石墨明暗和克制墨线重音描出；女子的黑衣更密实平滑，男子外套则向下散成更浅的灰笔痕。浅底上仍可见一道轻微接缝般的横线和淡纸渍。照明漫射且几乎无投影，主体与空白空间靠明度对比而非明确束光分开。没有可读文字。整体构图简净而忧郁，以两道集中的侧脸对照宽阔、近乎空白的地平线。
style_prompt_en: A restrained graphite-and-ink illustration places carefully modeled gray forms against a large warm off-white paper field. One or two near-black masses establish strong visual weight, while adjacent tones fade through fine crosshatching, smudged pencil and lightly washed gray. Contours are precise at focal transitions and dissolve into unfinished-looking marks at the outer edges. Sparse horizontal traces and tiny dark flecks make the extensive negative space feel inhabited without filling it. Light remains diffuse and low contrast within the pale field; depth comes from overlap and selective dark concentration. The composition is asymmetrically balanced, with dense tonal detail held against a quiet open expanse. The effect is intimate, muted and reflective.
style_prompt_zh: 克制的石墨与墨线插画把细致塑形的灰色形体置于大片暖灰白纸面前。一两块近黑色体量建立强视觉重量，邻近色调则通过纤细交叉排线、揉擦铅笔痕和浅灰洗色逐渐淡去。轮廓在焦点转折处精确，到了外缘则散成仿佛未完成的笔痕。稀疏横向痕迹和细小深色斑点让宽阔留白有了气息，却不填满它。浅色域内部的光漫射且对比很低；纵深来自重叠和选择性暗部集中。构图以不对称方式平衡，让密集明暗细节与安静开阔的区域相持。整体亲密、低声而沉思。
theme_en: Two downcast figures back to back in a quiet graphite-toned coastal drawing
theme_zh: 安静石墨色海岸素描中，两名低头人物背靠背站立
name: Joao Ruas
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
